BC_description: Most collection and control flow methods in the async library are now awaitable: if the final callback is omitted, these methods return a Promise instead of operating synchronously or expecting a callback. This changes the method signature and return value. Downstream code relying on synchronous return values, or that depends on passing callbacks to these methods, will need to adapt. Wrapping utility methods (like timeout, memoize, reflect, etc.) are not yet affected by this change and will not be awaitable at this time. Only collection and control flow methods listed in the commit messages are now awaitable when the callback is omitted.
